lead_headline: Restaurant tracker stalls with single Saturday lead; liquor licensing awakens with 9 status flips after two-day freeze; subscribers slip −1 despite mid-week rally

restaurant.blurb: 1 new lead Saturday: Wellness Sushi closed July on Congress Park's Colfax after 7-year vegan run. Active pipeline: 171 openings, 161 closures.

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications Saturday but 9 status changes break two-day silence — six businesses (Arbor Liquors, L.Chaim.MM, Thai Monkey Club, Hilton Garden Inn Downtown, Lucy's, Mint Indian) cleared delinquency to active; three (Bombshells Arapahoe, Adobo, M. Vince Nail Spa) flipped delinquent. One license removed. Week closes at 265 new applications vs. 11 prior week (24.1x surge) — Wednesday's 267-filing anomaly dominates while weekend processing resumes modest administrative churn. Status flux suggests routine compliance cycle independent of application flood.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Saturday extends citation blackout to 11 consecutive days — new record void period with no pickups since early August. Zero active sources. YTD frozen at 1,167 mentions (111 sources). Past 30 days: 119 mentions (4.0/day avg) makes current 11-day freeze 100% below baseline vs. typical 60-80 weekly norm. Eleven-day drought surpasses any prior weekend lull or holiday gap — indicates sustained pipeline disruption beyond standard news cycle variance, possibly syndication outage or monitoring tool failure affecting vendor feed.

subscriptions.blurb: Net −1 Friday (0 new, 1 canceled) erases prior day's +6 rally as acquisition flatlines into weekend. MTD slips to −13 (−0.9/day), while 90-day net holds at +72. Past week finishes +3 net (21 new, 18 canceled) vs. prior week's −16 (24 new, 40 canceled) — sharp churn compression (40→18 cancellations) drives modest recovery despite weekend stall. Thursday's 10-new spike isolated event; Friday's zero acquisition returns to recent dormancy pattern. August's −0.9/day MTD drag still trails +0.9/day YTD baseline. Week-over-week improvement real but fragile — need sustained 4-5 daily new subscribers to restore positive momentum; current weekend pause threatens nascent rebound.
